title: Application Security Engineer - Officer
description:
**Who We’re Looking For**
=========================

  

The State Street Cyber Security Architecture \& Engineering team is seeking an accomplished professional with proven expertise in Application Security (AppSec) and DevSec Ops . The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in application security, build , and release management, secure software development lifecycle ( S SDLC), and the automation of security processes within CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with general automation practices is essential. The ideal candidate will show eagerness to learn and grow in all aspects of technical solutioning and will design, implement, and support agile solutions and processes leveraged by a large number of applications hosted in our environment .


**What you will be responsible for**
====================================

* Help build our Dev Sec Ops \& AppSec Strategy to integrate cybersecurity into the organizational adoption and improvement of agile practices.
* Partner with Engineering tea ms to implement and operationalize Dev Sec Ops , and AppSec principles and processes.
* Assist application teams with onboarding to the adopted security tools/technologies; working with vendors to troubleshoot the platform and issues related to such integrations.
* Assist development community to triage GenAI models security scanning , and partner to remediate the security vulnerabilities.
* Deliver and communicate reporting via dashboard, and metrics.
* Develop and maintain application security and DevSecOps documentation.
* Assist in the audit processes and provide relevant documentation to close Audit findings.
* Work with teams to continuously improve Dev Sec Ops , \& Application Security processes and tools.
* Deliver tasks based on project objectives; technically support projects through to completion.
**What we value**
=================

These skills will help you succeed in this role :


* Experience developing software in technologies such as Java, .Net, Python, and Node.js etc.
* Experience in cloud technologies such as Azure and AWS.
* Extensive experience in application security space including SAST, DAST, SCA and Container security scanning .
* Current information security certification, including Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) .
* Experience with automation and orchestration tools, such as Ansible, Terraform, or Kubernetes, is valuable. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code ( IaC ) principles and experience in automating deployment and management tasks in a hybrid cloud environment is beneficial.
* Proven technical solutioning experience with current and emerging technologies including, but not limited to: Agile Development, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, System Hardening, DevSecOps , Cybersecurity, Cloud Security.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills across internal and external organizations.
* Ability to prioritize and manage several projects or priorities simultaneously.
**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
=========================================

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology (IT), computer science, or related field with 8 to 12 years of relevant experience.
* Experience in software development and software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Experience with application security tooling and its operations with modern CI/ CD, and DevSecOps best practices.
* Experience partnering with Dev community to influence without authority to adopt application security best practices, and tooling.
* Security\+ or other cybersecurity security certification.
* Experience with Agile and scrum practices.
**Work Requirement**
====================

**Hybrid:** Expected to work from base office location 4 days in a week


**Shift:** Standard business hours with flexibility to support global stakeholders across multiple time zones

======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. title: Recon Conversion Analyst​ - Senior Manager
description:
We are seeking a seasoned leader with a proven track record in managing Data Conversion (IBOR) within large\-scale, client\-facing transformation programs. The Officer will play a pivotal role in the Alpha Global Conversion Practice, overseeing strategy, planning, execution, and governance of end\-to\-end platform IBOR Conversion during Alpha implementations. These programs span complex business models and data flows across front, middle, and back office operations involving State Street, Charles River Development, clients, and industry partners.


**Why this role is important to us**

Alpha is the industry’s first global interoperable platform that unifies front, middle, and back office functions under one provider. Thorough Conversion of Alpha’s applications, data, and workflows is essential to accelerate implementation timelines, ensure consistent delivery, and provide a seamless client experience. The Officer will be instrumental in driving this transformation and ensuring high\-quality outcomes.


Specifically, the candidate will:


* Work with Business Leads to training, resolve questions, assess user needs and recommend changes
* Work on data analysis and data conversion of new Clients to an in\-house Middle Office system
* Work on the data conversion development lifecycle and methodology. This includes requirements analysis, solution design, client acceptance, timeline creation, implementation, unit testing, deployment tools, and maintenance
* Understand the current processes and tools used by State Street, and map new requirements to this tool
* Ability to create data maps, to map the data flow from legacy systems to the in\-house systems using existing functionality and processes
* Work on inputs and outputs from the conversion process, and communicate issues internally and externally as required
* Resolve issues and gaps in terms of data provided or discrepancies in data between legacy presentation and the future state model basis the feedback provided
* Work on the deliverables of conversion planning and testing in order to meet the milestones
* Participate in the actual conversion tests and dress rehearsals

**The ideal candidate should have:**

* Overall 12 to 18 Years of Industry Experience
* Good knowledge and experience in Capital markets – Middle, Back Office \& Front office is key
* 9\+ years of relevant Financial Industry Experience required, preferably Investment Management, Asset Management
* Great Understanding of Securities, Loans, IBOR/ABOR, Transaction Management
* Fair understanding \& experience on platforms like IBOR/ABOR, Eagle, Eagle Star, PAM, Portia, CRD
* Good Communication Skills with good external and internal client interfacing skills
* Manage a team of 10\-20 to meet onboarding goals
* Ability to work in a high paced environment, be flexible, follow tight deadlines, organize and prioritize work
* Ability to analyze and resolve project\-related issues and follow through with set objectives
* Experience working on projects related to Middle \& Back Office Client On boarding
* Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Access skills, as well as Microsoft Project or other project management software experience
* Bachelor’s Degree in Finance \& Accounting, Computer Science, Information Technology
* Nice to have :MBA in Finance, Management, Business Administration from Premier B School

title: Cslt-Prog & Proj Mgmt
description:
### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead SAM Flexera Expert to play a crucial "player\-coach" role within our Software Asset Management (SAM) function. You will architect the end\-to\-end publisher management strategy while actively working as a hands\-on implementor for our most complex, tier\-1 software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive enterprise\-wide continuous cost optimization programs, manually design and configure complex licensing frameworks, serve as the lead technical defender during major vendor audits, and mentor a team of SAM professionals.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Defining the end\-to\-end lifecycle strategy for software publishers within Flexera, while rolling up your sleeves to directly execute the onboarding, configuration, and compliance monitoring for critical tier\-1 vendors.
* Acting as the primary authority and hands\-on implementor for translating highly complex EULAs, MSAs, and amendments into accurate license records and product use rights (PUR) within the platform.
* Directing and executing continuous cost optimization initiatives, actively diving into the data to identify strategic opportunities regarding shelfware, hybrid cloud licensing, and enterprise\-wide application rationalization.
* Leading the defense and data strategy during major software vendor audits, collaborating closely with IT Procurement, Legal, and Sourcing teams to mitigate financial risk.
* Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands\-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.
* Overseeing the strategic roadmap and technically supporting the implementation of Flexera integrations with enterprise systems like ServiceNow CMDB, cloud portals (AWS/Azure/GCP), and discovery tools.
* Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
* Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a strategic leader and hands\-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent problem\-solving skills, a proven ability to execute complex platform configurations, and a passion for mentoring others. You thrive when balancing high\-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi\-million\-dollar cost\-saving opportunities.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* 9\+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on implementation and architecture experience in Flexera.
* Proven leadership experience blending end\-to\-end publisher lifecycle strategy with direct, hands\-on platform execution.
* Expert\-level understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, Red Hat, VMware/Broadcom).
* Extensive technical experience managing ecosystem integrations and databases, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, REST APIs, and discovery agent operations.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex licensing data into actionable business strategies for leadership.

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate data management tasks.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification and management of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software to mitigate security risks.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **Where you’ll be working**


In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**

title: IT Quality Specialist - Pharma R&D
description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

The IT Quality Specialist independently manages the end\-to\-end quality and analysis tasks across various capabilities and contributes to solving moderately complex business problems. You will lead the analysis of stakeholders needs, drive root cause analysis, and ensure comprehensive requirements traceability across large\-scale initiatives. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will champion accountability, mentor junior team members, and drive process improvements that align delivered solutions with overarching business goals.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and UX Designers, to define scope, solutions, constraints, and project risks.
* Manage compliance documentation processes and systems, characterizing business solutions for compliance with internal and external regulations.
* Be accountable for the creation and maintenance of:
* System Risk Assessments and Data Classification Reports.
* User Requirements and Functional/Technical Specifications.
* Validation Plans, Reports, and Registries.
* Requirements Traceability Matrices, Test Plans, and Test Reports.
* Data/Process flow diagrams and training documentation.
* Configure system settings and provide consultation to customers regarding solution enhancements and new implementations.
* Facilitate UAT planning and execution.
* Serve as a trusted partner for Global Privacy, IT Security, and Business Quality teams, maintaining expert\-level knowledge of governance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485\).
* Drive the resolution of business or systems issues throughout the project lifecycle.
* Enhance the creation and maintenance of compliance documentation (e.g., System Risk Assessments, Validation Plans, Requirements Traceability Matrices) by leveraging AI\-driven automation to reduce manual effort while maintaining compliance rigor.
* Implement AI\-assisted quality control tools to automate data validation, anomaly detection, and cross\-platform consistency checks, ensuring sustained data integrity and adherence to GxP/CSV standards at scale.
* Utilize AI\-powered analytical tools to monitor platform performance, proactively identify process bottlenecks, and generate audit\-ready compliance metrics.
* Guide the strategic deployment of AI agents within the IT Quality landscape, ensuring that AI\-assisted workflows remain compliant by design and effectively support business requirements.


Experience Profile
  
  

* 7\-10 years of related experience in an IT business systems analyst or IT quality assurance role.
* Strong domain knowledge of the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, manufacturing/quality assurance processes, and computer systems validation (CSV).
* Proven understanding of application development methodologies (Agile and Waterfall), including functional requirements, process modeling, and large\-scale system implementations.
* BA/BS degree in life science, informatics, business, or equivalent (MA/MS or post\-graduate coursework is a plus).
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build relationships, focus on the customer, and solve complex problems in fast\-paced environments.
* Strong capability to independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis.
* Ability to champion accountability by example, drive process improvement initiatives, and mentor junior team members.


\#Hyderabad2026
  
  

Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  

Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.

title: Lead IAM Analyst
description:
**Role Overview:**


We are seeking a detail\-oriented and self\-driven IAM Automation and Governance Specialist to enhance and automate our identity and access management (IAM) practices. The role will be primarily focused on integrating Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) with UKG (HRIS) systems, ensuring secure identity lifecycle management aligned with Zero Trust, least privilege, and regulatory compliance (HITRUST, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS).


**Key Responsibilities:**


**Identity \& Access Management:**


* Expert\-level experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)


* Hands\-on with Entitlement Management: Access Packages, Catalogs


* Proficient in Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Access Reviews, Conditional Access


* Automate Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver (JML) workflows and user lifecycle events


* Identify and remediate orphaned accounts and over\-permissioned users


* Strong understanding of RBAC and ABAC access control models.


**Scripting \& Automation:**


* Strong proficiency in PowerShell (Graph API, AzureAD, MSOnline, Az modules)


* Ability to automate:


* IAM data exports (e.g., PIM assignments, access packages)


* Sign\-in \& activity log queries


* Provisioning/Deprovisioning tasks


* Knowledge of modular and maintainable scripting best practices


**Security \& Compliance:**


* Understanding of frameworks: NIST 800\-53, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS


* Ability to map IAM controls to compliance framework


* Experience supporting audits through evidence gathering and documentation


**Azure Cloud \& Microsoft Ecosystem:**


* Manage Azure subscriptions, resource groups, and RBAC


* Experience with Intune, Defender for Endpoint, and Company Portal


* Troubleshoot Conditional Access and authentication issues


* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 Security \& Compliance Center


**Documentation \& Process Management:**


* Develop SOPs, process flows, and policy documents


* Create and maintain IAM maturity models and strategic roadmaps


* Prepare documentation to support regulatory audits


**Key Competencies:**


* Process Automation: Streamline IAM operations through scripting and workflows


* Security Focus: Deep understanding of IAM security challenges and solutions


* Analytical Thinking: Ability to evaluate and improve access control models


* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Bridge gaps between technical and business functions


* Regulatory Awareness: Strong foundation in data protection, access control standards, and compliance regulations


**Soft Skills:**


* Self\-motivated and capable of working independently


* Strong attention to detail with a security\-first mindset


* Excellent communication skills for technical and non\-technical stakeholders


* Strong collaboration across HR, IT, Security, and DevOps teams


**Education \& Experience:**


* Bachelor's in computer science, Information Security, or related field


* 8–10 years of experience in IAM or IT Security


* Experience integrating Microsoft Entra ID with HRIS platforms (preferably UKG)


* Background in IAM governance and automation in compliance\-heavy environments


**Preferred Certifications:**


* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator


* CISSP / CISM (or equivalent)


* Azure Security Engineer Associate
